_comment: Team-reviewed fixes for ingredients the FDC matcher gets wrong or can't match. Keys are normalised ingredient names, with "|canned" for canned products (e.g. "chickpea|canned"). Values: { "fdcId": <Foundation or SR Legacy id>, "note": "why" }. Known gaps without a verified id yet: "coconut milk" (search only returns the sweetened beverage and puddings) and "vegetable stock" (only beef, chicken and fish stock); both stay unresolved and lower completeness until added.
